decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory tied to the installed trailer base, it uses little organisational slack, so despite weak later visibility it is still worth keeping unless clear sales shortfalls appear.

After several years without visible continuation, this niche transporter line likely sits below aspiration and its more specialized resources are better redirected to stronger core business or new development.
Even though low-bed trailers fit the firm's core capabilities, the lack of visible follow-through by 2020-2021 suggests the series did not justify its complexity for a medium-sized producer.
High trailer covers complement existing trailers and can be supported through the current network with limited extra effort, which supports retaining them while uncertainty remains.
With another box trailer series already withdrawn and clear portfolio overlap, the continued weak visibility strongly indicates an aspiration shortfall and favors further rationalization.
